items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: The name 'Ellen' appears only in the interviewer's turn ('Alan or Ellen') as part of a list of names to be recorded; the interviewee does not mention Ellen or interact with them.

ctx.x: Not many of them. They may find them going to school. It's pretty good sometimes. But they can't play that real dance music, huh? Not those old-time numbers. I haven't heard... Oh, but they play something else. They play something else. They like the new music now. Yeah. I never do hear any of them. You know, I used to hear... When I grew up in Georgia, out in the country, I used to hear plenty of fiddle players and banjo pickers. Well, nobody played that up here with... He's the only one. ...and he's fast with…
No, they don't play my kind.
